$comment: Recorded Figma effects per component set, captured through the Plugin API. A test cannot call Figma, so this is the design side that tools/figma-effects/check.mjs compares against what the stylesheet actually renders. Re-capture whenever a master's effects change; the gate reports any component with no entry rather than passing it silently.

Button.note: 72 = 3 sizes x 3 sub-types x 4 types x 2 tones, i.e. every Focused variant and nothing else. Before 2026-09-03 this set also carried 24 hover elevations and 48 resting shadows on outlined and text buttons, inherited from the UX4G set it descends from.

IconButton.note: Same shape. Before 2026-09-03 it also carried 24 hover elevations, multiplied through the 45 -> 180 -> 360 rebuild because a clone brings its parent's effects with it.

ButtonGroup.note: Composed of Button instances; the group itself paints nothing.

Link.note: Text with a bottom rule. The focus ring is drawn as an outline in code and is not modelled as an effect here.
